title: Notes and stats from the Buccaneers 24-16 win over the Cowboys

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Notes and stats from the Buccaneers 24-16 win over the Cowboys
sources.description: – The Tampa Bay Buccaneers defeated the Dallas Cowboys, 24-16, on Thursday Night Football. With the win Buccaneers General Manager Jason Licht earned the 100th win of his career in Tampa Bay, including playoffs, becoming the first general manager in franchise history to reach the 100-win milestone. – Head Coach Todd Bowles picked up his 37th career win as Buccaneers head coach, […]
